name: Global Citizenship
description: Introduces students to global responsibilities, cultural awareness, and ethical participation in an interconnected world.

name: Critical Thinking and Logic
description: Builds foundational reasoning skills, argument analysis, and evidence-based decision making across disciplines.

name: Academic Writing
description: Develops clear, structured, and persuasive writing for essays, reports, and research communication.

name: Research Methods
description: Covers qualitative and quantitative research design, data collection, and basic interpretation techniques.

name: Digital Literacy
description: Strengthens practical skills in digital tools, online collaboration, information evaluation, and cybersecurity awareness.

name: Data Fundamentals
description: Introduces core concepts in data representation, cleaning, visualization, and introductory statistical thinking.

name: Programming Principles
description: Teaches variables, control flow, functions, and problem decomposition through beginner-friendly coding tasks.

name: Artificial Intelligence Foundations
description: Explores key AI concepts, machine learning basics, responsible AI use, and real-world applications.

name: Systems Thinking
description: Examines complex systems, feedback loops, and holistic approaches to solving societal and technical problems.

name: Project Management Basics
description: Introduces planning, scheduling, risk management, and teamwork practices for successful project delivery.

name: Entrepreneurship and Innovation
description: Focuses on idea generation, market validation, business models, and iterative product development.

name: Sustainability Studies
description: Investigates environmental, social, and economic sustainability challenges and practical intervention strategies.

name: Intercultural Communication
description: Enhances communication across cultures through empathy, inclusive language, and context-aware interaction.

name: Ethics in Technology
description: Analyzes privacy, bias, accountability, and governance issues in modern technological systems.

name: Capstone Preparation
description: Prepares students to define project scope, research goals, and implementation plans for final capstone work.
